correctness.rationale: The bracket equations yield D=δT(D). The two singleton, two edge and m−1 interior weight blocks exhaust the space. With u=m/2−j the interior determinant is (t−1)[t(t−1)−m(m+2)/4], and the edge determinant is (t−1)(t+m/2). Distinct roots give the three stable multiplicities; at m=p−2 and m=p−1 the repeated root has geometric multiplicity one per interior block, as verified by the minors on the first and third coordinates (pivots −(j+1),j+1 and −j,j+1 respectively). Edge ranks and singletons give p+1 at δ=1 for m=p−2, and p,p+2 at δ=1,2 for m=p−1. At p=3,m=1 there is no interior block and thus no actual zero root; the conclusion remains p+1. The trivial module and δ=0 vanish by perfectness. These are field-independent determinant and rank tests in odd prime characteristic. Fresh bracket-equation row reductions over F3 and F5 passed all 34 cases; the frozen checker was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: The empirical check is bounded to p=3,5; the symbolic proof, not the replay, covers other fields. No formal or specialist attestation is asserted.
